item.title: Euler Conjecture and CDC 6600
item.description:
📝 They reported that they had used a program that used direct search on a CDC 6600 to obtain one counterexample to Euler’s Sum Of Powers Conjecture. Some details on the search algorithm used in the 1966 paper may be seen in another paper, https://www. org/journals/mcom/1967-21-097/S0025-5718-1967-0220669-3/S0025-5718-1967-0220669-3.
🔗 Read more: https://fortran-lang.discourse.group/t/euler-conjecture-and-cdc-6600/10501
